name: Australia Awards Scholarships
award_summary: Full tuition, return airfare, establishment allowance, living stipend, health cover, academic support
key_eligibility: India track is nomination-only via ~15 partner institutions (IITs, DU, BHU, etc.), not a general open application
application_route: Yes — via nominating institution
deadline_or_cycle: General portal shows 30 Apr 2026 for 2027 intake
status: Recurring; India nomination route requires verification
editorial_note: CAUTION: India-specific page shows a stale 2019/20 cycle. Confirm current India eligibility and nomination status with Australia Awards India before advising clients — do not promise this to walk-in clients without verifying an open India cycle first.

name: Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarship
eligible_fields: All subjects offered by the university
award_summary: 20% tuition fee remission for the course duration for scholarships awarded from 2027
key_eligibility: International students from countries with GDP per capita ≤ US$10,000 (India qualifies); completed secondary education outside Australia; no prior tertiary study
application_route: No — automatic on eligible program application
editorial_note: One of the more reliable, high-value automatic scholarships for Indian UG applicants.

name: Monash RTP Stipend
award_summary: AUD 37,145 per year in 2026 plus eligible relocation allowance; international candidates may pair with a tuition scholarship
key_eligibility: International applicant; competitive academic record, research outputs and experience; English requirements
application_route: Apply with Monash graduate research scholarship application
editorial_note: Make clear that tuition coverage is a separate award for international students

name: RMIT Future Leaders Scholarship
award_summary: 20% tuition fee reduction for full program duration
key_eligibility: Specifically targeted at students from India and the Indian subcontinent
application_route: Confirm at application — largely automatic with offer
editorial_note: Good headline scholarship to mention since it is explicitly branded for Indian-subcontinent applicants.

name: Research Training Program (RTP)
award_summary: University may offer tuition fee offset, living stipend and/or research allowances
key_eligibility: International student enrolled in an accredited higher degree by research; university selection rules apply
application_route: Apply through each participating university
editorial_note: Do not show one universal deadline or stipend; link to the chosen university's RTP page

name: Sydney International Undergraduate Academic Excellence Scholarship
award_summary: 100% tuition fees and Student Services and Amenities Fee for the published full-time degree duration
key_eligibility: Outstanding international applicant applying for an eligible single undergraduate degree
application_route: Separate university scholarship process; confirm current intake instructions
editorial_note: Keep deadline dynamic because the university updates it by intake

name: University of Adelaide College International Scholarship
award_summary: 10% reduction on annual tuition fees for standard course duration
key_eligibility: Open to citizens of any country except Australia/NZ; must be a graduate of the University of Adelaide College pathway program
application_route: No — automatically assessed on offer acceptance
editorial_note: Only relevant for clients routed through the Adelaide College foundation/pathway program, not direct university entry.

name: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships Scheme
award_summary: AUD 5,000–60,000 depending on ranking; normally paid in first year
key_eligibility: International student with an unconditional offer who has not commenced the degree
application_route: Automatic consideration after unconditional admission offer
deadline_or_cycle: 2027 Semester 1 rounds: 17 Aug, 5 Oct and 16 Nov 2026
editorial_note: Useful broad-access listing because there is no separate scholarship application

name: AAUW International Fellowship
eligible_fields: STEM disciplines for the current cycle
award_summary: May be used for tuition, fees, books, living expenses and dependent care; amount depends on degree category/current call
key_eligibility: Woman; non-US citizen/permanent resident; first eligible graduate degree; full-time; minimum 3.5/4.0 GPA; admitted/enrolled by stated date
application_route: Direct application to AAUW
deadline_or_cycle: 17 Aug–17 Sep 2026 for the 2027–28 award year
editorial_note: Do not market to all applicants: current program is women-only and STEM-focused

name: Clark University Presidential / Merit Scholarships
award_summary: Merit scholarships and limited need-based grants; most international recipients still contribute substantially toward annual costs
key_eligibility: All admitted international students automatically considered; no India-specific restriction
application_route: No — automatic on admission
deadline_or_cycle: Tied to admission round (Early Action/Early Decision/Regular Decision)
editorial_note: Typical net cost after aid runs ~$40,000/year even with scholarship — set client expectations accordingly.

name: Fulbright-Nehru Master's Fellowships
eligible_fields: Selected fields including economics, public health, sustainability, journalism and planning
award_summary: Tuition and fees, living costs, J-1 support, round-trip airfare and health coverage; grant may not cover every cost
key_eligibility: Indian citizen; normally 55%+; qualifying degree; 3 years relevant paid work; leadership/community service; return commitment
application_route: Apply through USIEF; placement is handled by IIE
deadline_or_cycle: Annual cycle; next call must be verified
status: Recurring; current page shows prior cycle
editorial_note: Publish only after replacing the old deadline with the live competition deadline

name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
award_summary: Up to three years of graduate funding including tuition and living support under program terms
key_eligibility: Citizen of any country; admission to Stanford graduate program; first bachelor's degree within the stated seven-year window
application_route: Separate applications to Knight-Hennessy and the Stanford graduate program
deadline_or_cycle: Annual autumn deadline; verify current cohort
editorial_note: Good stretch listing; the bachelor's-year rule changes with every cohort

name: MIT International Undergraduate Financial Aid
award_summary: MIT commits to meet 100% of demonstrated financial need for admitted international undergraduates
key_eligibility: Admitted international undergraduate; submit CSS Profile and requested family-income verification
application_route: Apply for admission and financial aid separately
deadline_or_cycle: Normally 15 February for aid documents; verify application year
editorial_note: Label as need-based financial aid rather than a merit scholarship

name: University of Tulsa International Academic Award + Global Ambassador Award
award_summary: Renewable partial tuition awards; academic award level depends on the current admission profile and separate leadership awards may be stackable
key_eligibility: Open to all international students; Ambassador award needs proof of competition/leadership recognition
application_route: Academic Award: automatic; Ambassador & #YouAreWelcomeHere: separate submission required
editorial_note: Good mid-tier option for strong-but-not-Ivy-League profiles — stackable awards add up meaningfully.

name: Yale International Undergraduate Financial Aid
award_summary: Need-based package meeting 100% of demonstrated need; qualifying international packages can include housing, meals and travel allowances
key_eligibility: Admitted Yale College undergraduate; financial documentation required
application_route: Apply for admission and Yale financial aid
editorial_note: Label as need-based aid; Yale does not award undergraduate merit scholarships

name: Chevening Scholarship
award_summary: Tuition subject to program rules, monthly living allowance, travel and other approved costs
key_eligibility: Indian citizen/resident under current rules; undergraduate degree; 2,800 hours post-graduation work experience; apply to three eligible courses; return-home commitment
application_route: Chevening online application plus university applications
editorial_note: High-value live listing; preserve exact timezone and update after closing

name: Clarendon Scholarship
award_summary: Course fees plus a living-cost grant for the fee-liability period
key_eligibility: Any nationality; outstanding academic merit and potential; apply by the relevant December/January course funding deadline
application_route: Automatic consideration with timely Oxford graduate application
editorial_note: Strong universal graduate listing; no separate scholarship form

name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
eligible_fields: Programs aligned to CSC development themes
award_summary: Approved tuition, airfare, living allowance and applicable study support under CSC terms
key_eligibility: Indian citizen/permanent resident; normally first degree at 2:1 or 2:2 plus relevant postgraduate qualification; unable to afford UK study
application_route: CSC application plus Indian nominating-agency process where applicable
deadline_or_cycle: 8 Sep–20 Oct 2026 for study beginning Sep/Oct 2027
editorial_note: Add the current Indian nominating-body instructions before publishing

name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarship
eligible_fields: Development-focused subjects (varies by university's approved course list)
award_summary: Approved tuition, living stipend, airfare and other allowances under current CSC terms
key_eligibility: Indian citizen; competitive — no more than 50% of a university's nominees may come from India, Pakistan, Nigeria and Ghana combined
application_route: Yes — apply via CSC online form plus separate university admission
deadline_or_cycle: University bidding closed 15 Sep 2026; candidate applications open ~Nov 2026 for 2027-28 intake
editorial_note: Only available on specific pre-approved courses each year — check the current course list before promising this to a client.

name: Felix Scholarship
award_summary: Typically course fees, living-cost support and return travel under host-institution terms
key_eligibility: Outstanding Indian applicant; financial need and host-university admission requirements apply
application_route: Apply to host university; Oxford candidates follow Oxford funding process
editorial_note: Create separate child records for Oxford, Reading and SOAS because rules differ

name: GREAT Scholarships for India
award_summary: Usually GBP 10,000 toward tuition; some university awards are higher
key_eligibility: Indian passport holder and permanent resident; undergraduate degree; university admission and English requirements
application_route: Apply through a participating university
editorial_note: Store participating university as a child table because institutions and courses change annually

name: Rhodes Scholarship for India
award_summary: Oxford course fees, stipend and approved travel/visa-related support under Rhodes terms
key_eligibility: Indian citizenship; specified India education/residency connection; age window; undergraduate degree and strong academic/leadership profile
application_route: Direct Rhodes application followed by Oxford application if selected
editorial_note: Five India awards; show next-cycle alert rather than an Apply Now button while closed

name: DSU / Regional Right-to-Study Scholarship (EDISU Piemonte, and equivalents in other regions)
eligible_fields: All subjects at public Italian universities
award_summary: Regional income- and merit-based support that can combine a cash grant, tuition relief, accommodation and meals; values vary by region
key_eligibility: Non-EU students, including Indian nationals, are fully eligible provided they meet the income threshold (ISEE Università ≤ €26,306.25); merit credit requirement from year 2 onward
application_route: Yes — region-specific application plus mandatory consular income certification (start this step 4-8 weeks ahead, ideally by June)
deadline_or_cycle: Primary window Sep-Oct annually; varies by region
editorial_note: Income-based, not purely merit-based — very high value for cost-conscious families but the consular paperwork timeline is the main risk point to flag to clients.

name: International Talents @Unibo
award_summary: Current known call provides tuition exemption plus grant paid in performance-linked instalments; exact amount is cycle-specific
key_eligibility: International qualification; admission to eligible master's; academic/test and financial documentation rules set annually
application_route: Separate Unibo scholarship application
deadline_or_cycle: Annual; next call must be verified
status: Recurring; current searchable call is older
editorial_note: Do not publish the 2025–26 amount as current until the new call is live

name: Invest Your Talent in Italy
provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs / ICE / Uni-Italia
award_summary: Nine-month scholarship; participating universities may also provide tuition support; exact award amount follows the annual call
key_eligibility: Indian citizen permanently resident in India; qualifying degree; admission to an eligible listed course; current students/graduates of Italian universities excluded
application_route: Direct IYT portal application
editorial_note: Includes a compulsory internship; update amount directly from each annual call before publishing

name: Italian Government Scholarship (MAECI)
study_level: Master's, PhD, AFAM (arts/music/dance), research, Italian language courses (not Bachelor's)
award_summary: Annual grant paid under the current call terms, with qualifying health-insurance support
key_eligibility: India is among ~141 eligible countries; completed bachelor's, typically under 28 for Master's, B2-level English or Italian required
application_route: Yes — apply directly via the Study in Italy portal, before university admission
deadline_or_cycle: ~26 Mar annually (2026-27 cycle) — reconfirm exact date each year
editorial_note: Applicants apply for the scholarship first and get matched to a university afterward — different order from most other scholarships on this list, worth calling out to clients.

name: Merit Based International Scholarships
eligible_fields: English-taught MSc programs at specified campuses
award_summary: Tuition waiver; current tiers include up to EUR 10,000 gross Platinum and EUR 8,000 gross Gold
key_eligibility: International applicant to first year of an eligible English-taught MSc; selection based on academic profile
application_route: Apply for MSc admission and scholarship under the annual call
editorial_note: Funding tier and campus rules differ; model tiers as separate benefits

name: Padua International Excellence Scholarship
award_summary: EUR 8,000 gross per year plus tuition-fee waiver; regional fee and stamp remain payable
key_eligibility: Non-Italian applicant educated abroad applying to an eligible English-taught program; top academic profile
application_route: Usually considered through the relevant degree application/selection
editorial_note: Maximum 2 years for master's and 3 years for bachelor's/single-cycle under current terms

name: International Student Entrance Scholarship
award_summary: CAD 10,000 for first year
key_eligibility: International fee-paying student admitted to eligible full-time first-year degree; exclusions apply to transfers, deferred offers and certain programs
application_route: Automatic consideration / award under current rules
editorial_note: Good core listing because no separate scholarship application is required

name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
award_summary: Tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years
key_eligibility: International student in final secondary-school year/recent graduate; starting first undergraduate degree; exceptional academics, creativity and leadership; school nomination
application_route: School nomination, U of T admission, then invited scholarship application
deadline_or_cycle: 9 Oct 2026 school nomination; 16 Oct admission; 6 Nov scholarship documents
editorial_note: Around 37 scholars annually; warn that U of T does not use agents for this award

name: Mathematics International Elite and Excellence Awards: India
eligible_fields: Faculty of Mathematics except specified excluded joint programs
award_summary: India Elite: CAD 40,000; India Excellence: CAD 20,000, paid in first year
key_eligibility: Indian citizenship; admitted international student in an eligible Mathematics program; academic merit
application_route: Automatic consideration with admission under current scheme
editorial_note: One of the most practical India-specific university awards in the dataset

name: McGill Entrance Scholarships
award_summary: One-year CAD 3,000; major renewable awards total CAD 12,000–48,000
key_eligibility: First-time full-time undergraduate; academic excellence; major awards also consider leadership
application_route: Automatic consideration for one-year award; separate application for major award
editorial_note: Explain the difference between automatic one-year and application-based major awards

name: UBC International Major Entrance Scholarship
key_eligibility: Entering directly from secondary school, exceptional academics plus strong extracurricular record, must hold/obtain a Canadian study permit
application_route: No — automatic consideration with admission application
deadline_or_cycle: Tied to UBC's regular admission cycle
editorial_note: One of the more generous automatic UG entrance awards for strong Indian applicants applying straight from school.

name: UBC International Scholars Program
award_summary: Meaningful need-based support determined after family financial assessment; amount is individualized
key_eligibility: International secondary-school entrant; first undergraduate degree; all-As-equivalent academics, leadership/community contribution and significant financial need
application_route: School nomination plus UBC admission and separate award application
deadline_or_cycle: 2027 intake opens Sep/Oct 2026; current page indicates 15 Nov award/application deadline
editorial_note: Some degrees are excluded; do not state a fixed award amount

name: University of Waterloo International Master's Award of Excellence (IMAE)
award_summary: CAD 2,500/term, for up to 5 terms
key_eligibility: International master's students; award is faculty-nominated, not self-applied
application_route: Yes — requires faculty nomination
deadline_or_cycle: Tied to program/faculty nomination timeline — no fixed date
editorial_note: Modest amount relative to others on this list — best pitched as a stackable top-up, not a headline scholarship.

name: DAAD EPOS
award_summary: EUR 992 monthly for graduates; doctoral rate EUR 1,400 from Feb 2026, plus insurance and travel allowance; possible rent/family support
key_eligibility: Graduate from an eligible developing/emerging country with at least 2 years relevant professional experience; course-specific requirements
application_route: Apply to up to three listed EPOS courses using DAAD documents
editorial_note: India eligibility should be rechecked in the live country selector for each call

name: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt Programme
eligible_fields: Public policy, governance, international relations, public management, peace/development
award_summary: Monthly scholarship, insurance, travel and mandatory pre-study German course under current call
key_eligibility: High-achieving graduate from developing/emerging country with relevant civic, political or social commitment; selected courses only
application_route: Apply directly to up to two participating master's programs
deadline_or_cycle: Usually 1 Jun–31 Jul; verify current call
editorial_note: Suitable for both young graduates and professionals; practical only for specified fields

name: DAAD Study Scholarship (Master's, All Academic Disciplines)
award_summary: Monthly stipend plus applicable travel, insurance and study allowances under the current DAAD call
key_eligibility: Indian bachelor's degree graduates; specific programme-level criteria apply and vary by field
application_route: Yes — via DAAD's online portal
deadline_or_cycle: 31 Oct annually (for the following October intake)
editorial_note: The go-to funded route for German master's — encourage clients to start the DAAD portal search early since criteria differ significantly by discipline.

name: DAAD Study Scholarships for STEM Disciplines
eligible_fields: Mathematics, computer science, natural sciences, engineering
award_summary: EUR 992 monthly, insurance, travel allowance and EUR 460 annual study allowance; possible rent/family and language support
key_eligibility: High-achieving applicant from developing/emerging country; qualifying first degree; no prior master's; tuition-free full-time on-campus STEM master's
application_route: Direct DAAD application
editorial_note: Excellent India-audience fit; deadline is the date this dataset was verified

name: Deutschlandstipendium
provider: Federal government + private co-sponsors, administered per university
award_summary: €300/month, non-repayable, funded for the standard study duration (renewable subject to minimum grade/credit progress)
key_eligibility: Enrolled or incoming students at the specific participating university; eligibility for international students varies by institution and should be confirmed per university
application_route: Yes — separate application per university
deadline_or_cycle: Varies by university, typically a summer application window — exact 2027/28 dates announced each spring
editorial_note: Modest but stackable with tuition-free public university study — worth mentioning as a living-cost supplement, not a primary funding source.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree (EMJMD) Scholarship
study_level: Master's (joint degree, 2+ institutions, often including a German partner)
award_summary: Full funding: tuition, travel and installation costs, monthly living allowance
key_eligibility: Open worldwide, including India; requires a completed bachelor's degree (or final-year status)
application_route: Yes — apply directly to the chosen consortium/programme
deadline_or_cycle: Varies by consortium, typically Oct 2026-Jan 2027 for Fall 2027 entry
editorial_note: Not Germany-exclusive — the German partner university is just one leg of a multi-country joint degree; frame it that way to clients so expectations are accurate.

name: Friedrich Ebert Foundation Scholarship for International Students
award_summary: Foreign students currently receive up to EUR 992 monthly for study or EUR 1,500 for doctoral funding plus possible health-insurance support
key_eligibility: Must already live in Germany and study at a German university; very good German; strong academics and social-democratic/social engagement
application_route: Direct FES application after meeting Germany-based conditions
editorial_note: Do not present as a pre-arrival scholarship; applicant generally must already be in Germany

name: Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung International Scholarship
award_summary: Monthly support under program rules; doctoral scholarship currently listed at EUR 1,400 per month; possible additional support
key_eligibility: Non-EU international applicant; strong academics and social/political engagement; minimum B2 German; master's normally four semesters
application_route: Follow KAS international application/country call instructions
editorial_note: Not a good fit for applicants without B2 German or demonstrated civic engagement

name: Inlaks Shivdasani Scholarship
eligible_fields: Most fields except Business, Engineering (Imperial College exception), Computer Science, Medicine, MBA
award_summary: Up to USD 120,000 covering tuition, living expenses, travel, visa and health cover
key_eligibility: Indian passport holder resident in India, born on/after 1 Jan 1996, bachelor's from a recognized Indian university (65% humanities/social sciences, 70% sciences/maths); must already hold an admission offer before applying
application_route: Yes
deadline_or_cycle: Annual cycle (2026 round closed — confirm 2027 dates on inlaksfoundation.org)
editorial_note: Country-agnostic within UK/Europe/USA — worth featuring once on the site with a note that it applies across those three destinations, not just USA.

name: JN Tata Endowment Loan Scholarship
award_summary: Interest-free loan-scholarship, amount assessed case-by-case after interview
key_eligibility: Indian nationals who completed undergraduate studies at a recognized Indian university, admitted (or applying) for study abroad in any country
application_route: Yes
deadline_or_cycle: 5 Jan – 29 Mar 2026 (for Fall 2026-Spring 2027 cycle; next cycle opens ~Jan 2027)
editorial_note: Not a pure scholarship — part loan — but genuinely useful to list as a funding-gap-filler alongside the country-specific awards.
